summary: Broadly Augmented Bidirectional Integrated Language (BABIL) By John LaRocco Summary In today’s interconnected world, people from all backgrounds interact with one another and require a reliable and accurate way to communicate despite existing language barriers. Language learning and comprehension is a difficult task that many endure and people need a way to comprehend other languages in an accurate, fast, efficient, and comfortable manner. Broadly Augmented Bidirectional Integrated Language (BABIL) aims to tackle this problem and provide a solution that fits the needs of the stakeholders while staying within the constraints of the real world.
